note_b: Or ‘brook.’ The Hebrew names a wadi or watercourse without ‘of Egypt’; identification with the Wadi of Egypt is contextual. A wadi is a streambed or watercourse, often seasonal.

decision.strongest_countercase: Readers who skip notes can mistake inferred Egypt for explicit Hebrew; retention with disclosure is defensible but not established as optimal.
decision.scope: Move place-name note[a] to its referent and qualify note[b]/connected rationale, preserving Hebrew, main words and historic revisions.
